about: Labelled personal notes for search evaluation (scripts/eval_search.py, tests/test_search_eval_real.py). Paragraph ids are '<note id>.<index>' (0-based, in order). 'topic' groups notes that are genuinely related; a note whose topic no other note shares should get no related notes. Invented content: names, numbers and passwords are fake.

notes.title: Postgres tips
paras: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) shows real timings; a Seq Scan on a big table usually means a missing index.

VACUUM FULL rewrites the table and takes an exclusive lock, never run it on prod during the day.

notes.title: git cheatsheet
paras:
```bash
git rebase -i HEAD~3
```
Undo the last commit but keep changes: git reset --soft HEAD~1
Find which commit broke it: git bisect start, git bisect bad, git bisect good v1.4.0

notes.title: Python asyncio gotcha
paras: asyncio.gather swallows nothing but cancels nothing either: if one task raises, the others keep running unless you use a TaskGroup.
Never call time.sleep inside a coroutine, it blocks the whole event loop. Use await asyncio.sleep.

```python
async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as tg:
    tg.create_task(fetch(url))
```

notes.title: nginx 502 debugging
paras: 502 Bad Gateway from nginx = upstream not answering. Check the gunicorn socket path matches proxy_pass.
Fixed: gunicorn was bound to 127.0.0.1:8001 but nginx pointed at 8000. Also raised proxy_read_timeout to 60s.

notes.title: Rust borrow checker notes
paras: error[E0502]: cannot borrow `v` as mutable because it is also borrowed as immutable - clone the value or end the first borrow before pushing.
Prefer iter().map().collect() over manual loops with push, the compiler can elide bounds checks.
